title: Gophish
summary: Open-source framework for authorized phishing-simulation campaigns.
whyThisMatters: Gophish gave organizations a self-hosted option for measuring and improving phishing awareness. Its function requires careful authorization, transparent policy, and protection of collected data.

sections.overview:
Gophish is open-source software for authorized phishing simulations.

Security awareness

Organizations use simulations to measure how staff respond to security-awareness exercises and to improve training.

The project documentation describes administrative and campaign-server configuration.

Responsible use

Phishing simulations should have organizational authorization and safeguards for participants and collected information.

timeline.event: Gophish is documented as a security tool.
